title: Influence bound from deterministic depth
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, and let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube. If a deterministic decision tree computing the real-valued sign representation of $f$ has depth at most $k$, then the total influence of that representation is at most $\sqrt{k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
The deterministic decision-tree depth of its real-valued sign representation is at most $k$
